goal: Defeat Erika for the Rainbow Badge

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from the Route 6 Gate back to Vermilion City to prepare
Fully heal the party at the Vermilion Pokemon Center
Buy Fresh Water from the Celadon Department Store (since the Vermilion Mart does not sell it and it is needed for the Route 6 guard)
Travel from Vermilion City to Celadon City, giving Fresh Water to the guard at the Route 6 Gate
Visit the Pokemon Center in Celadon City to fully heal the party
Battle and defeat Gym Leader Erika
